adjudication.reason: Subagent outputs contain count inconsistencies and several proposed POS values outside the canonical POS contract. No candidate was auto-applied.
obvious_candidate_classes: English/Russian contamination such as so as to inside a Russian translation
clear translation errors such as within 50 miles translated as an exact distance
obvious OCR/spelling defects such as St. Petersbourg
examples whose English and Russian meanings clearly disagree
offensive or obsolete wording in pedagogical examples
requires_manual_review: POS changes to labels not present in canonical schema
register removal without exact source evidence
changes where source page/line evidence is weak or machine-readable evidence is absent

process_findings: Preflight and subagents count examples differently: 1350 meaning examples vs 1386 reported examples.
Reported high-confidence/review counts do not always equal the number of listed findings.
Some agents propose POS labels outside the canonical schema; a schema gate must reject these before parent review.
Local source extraction needs stable page/line anchors; several reports cite only a PDF entry without precise coordinates.
Automated contamination, duplicate-example, malformed-English, unsupported-register, and offensive-content scans should run before semantic agents.
The parent model should review only normalized candidate records, not raw prose findings.
